import sqlite3

def store_user_data(name, email, bio):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (name, email, bio) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{bio}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"User {name} stored successfully")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    name = input('Enter name: ')
    email = input('Enter email: ')
    bio = input('Enter bio: ')
    store_user_data(name, email, bio)
